override: An explicit advanced configuration is active. These settings are read-only; relaunch without --config to use saved desktop settings.
language_help: Choose English or Deutsch. Language changes presentation only, not competition times or protocol data.
source_help: Connect the USB base station, refresh the list and select its port. Close other applications that use it.
found: The saved USB device was found on {port}. Confirm before using this port.
test_help: The current reader pauses briefly during a test. Incoming test lines remain safely stored. Opening a port does not by itself identify the firmware.
time_failed: The time command could not be written.
not_identity: Write success is not firmware acknowledgement. Verify the device and station time before racing.
port_unavailable: Unable to open {port}. It may be unplugged or in use by another application.
data_help: This location is separate from the installed program. Updates and uninstall leave competition data intact.
data_action: What should happen to the data?
move_help: Copy/Move never overwrite an existing destination. Move keeps a named recovery copy at the old location. A safety backup is made first.
live_help: FoxLive opens in your browser. The server listens on this computer only. Advanced settings normally need no changes.
backup_help: Create a consistent backup, then download it to another disk or USB drive. A backup on this disk alone cannot protect against disk failure.
backup_created: Backup created. Download it for a separate safety copy.
restore_help: Restore replaces competition data, not current COM/browser settings. A safety backup is made before replacement. Do not run another FoxSuite/CLI writer during restore.
shutdown_help: Closing a browser tab does not stop FoxSuite. Use this button to close serial, TimeSync and the database safely.
confirm_shutdown: Shut down FoxSuite? Live reception will stop.
stopped: FoxSuite has stopped. You may close this browser window.
confirm_data: Change the data location and restart? Confirm that no other FoxSuite/CLI process is using this database.
confirm_restore: Replace current competition data with this backup and restart? A safety backup will be created first.
restart_help: Open FoxSuite again from the Start menu if it has not reconnected. See the application log if needed.
choose_backup: Choose a FoxSuite backup file first.
error.override: Explicit configuration is read-only in desktop settings
error.restarting: FoxSuite is restarting; wait for it to reconnect
error.existing: Destination must contain an existing FoxSuite database
error.destination: Destination database already exists; choose Use existing instead
error.folder: Choose an absolute data folder, not a drive root
error.confirm_restore: Confirm restore; current competition data will be replaced
error.browse: Native folder selection is available in the Windows desktop app; otherwise enter an absolute folder path
error.busy: FoxSuite is already running for this user
error.port: Select a FoxIdentServer port before finishing setup
error.operation: Unable to complete this operation. Check folder permissions, free disk space and the log.
identity_missing: The saved USB identity is missing or ambiguous. Reception is paused. Select and confirm the correct port.
